resources.string: Displays HHmm time and battery / notification count on Glyph Matrix when locked and flipped.
Flip to Glyph Clock & Status Display
Turn off Always-on Glyph at set times
Flip to Glyph (Always-on) is turned off during this time range.
Turn off Glyph when screen wakes
To enable this clock when the phone is locked and flipped, select \"Clock & Status Matrix\" in Nothing OS Settings > Glyph Interface > Flip to Glyph > Always-on Glyph Toy.
Opening Nothing OS Toys Manager (Go to Settings > Glyph Interface)
Time: %1$s | Battery: %2$d%% | Temp: %3$d° | Weather: %4$s | Unread: %5$d | Widget: %6$s
Select the widgets to show. When there are notifications, the notification widget is shown first.
Approximate location is sufficient. Location coordinates are sent to Open-Meteo (api.open-meteo.com) to provide weather information.
Allow notification access to show the unread notification count.

Location permission is required to show the current temperature. Approximate location is sufficient. Location coordinates are sent to the weather provider Open-Meteo (api.open-meteo.com); without permission, IP-based location lookup (ipwho.is) may be used instead.
